title: Kade Voss | Bounty Hunter
synopsis: On the lawless frontier of a distant galaxy, veteran bounty hunter Kade Voss tracks dangerous criminals across alien worlds. Armed with experience, determination, and a trusted shotgun, he takes on jobs where survival is never guaranteed.
